g: (often Internet slang) The sound of a kiss, to indicate blowing a kiss to someone.
Thanks guys. 3 kisses for you all: mwah mwah mwah!
The hallmark sound of a fretless bass guitar played with a certain technique, where treble frequencies increase gradually after the attack.
Play it again, but with more mwah this time.
(colloquial) To kiss in an exaggerated fashion, especially without making contact.
A teacher in parts of Africa.
A traditional king or ruler in various African nations.
An alcoholic drink of Uganda, made with fermented bananas and sorghum.
